title: Art Sparks

services.name: Summer Camp
services.desc: at Art Sparks provides theme-based creative experiences during which children get to explore a variety of media such as acrylics, collage, watercolors, pastels, charcoal, printmaking, sculpture, assemblage, colored pencils, clay and much more. Summer camp sessions are 1/2 day - morning or afternoon (with the exception of the week of August 10 - 14, for which there is half or full day option).
